name: Open-Meteo Geocoding
tagline: Free, no-key place search with coordinates, population, and timezone metadata
description: Open-Meteo Geocoding is a free public API that converts place names into geographic coordinates and metadata. Search by city or location name to get latitude, longitude, elevation, population, country codes, and timezone—without an API key for non-commercial use.

auth.details: No authentication required for non-commercial use. Commercial use requires an API key from Open-Meteo customer dashboard.

use_cases: resolve a city name to lat/lon for weather lookups
autocomplete place names in a location search UI
